## What changes for a caller

<!-- What a caller notices, or "nothing" for a change inside the library. -->

## Checks

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q -n auto` passes, and `mkdocs build --strict` builds the site.
- [ ] A decision made or revised has its record in `docs/decisions/`, in the same commit.
- [ ] A rule in `AGENTS.md` that this change needs changed is named here, with the reason.
- [ ] A model family not covered before has its test template in `tests/templates/`.
